payload.summary: Planned a bounded, dry-run-first reconciliation surface backed by exact operation-attempt ownership. The selected design adds durable claim fencing, provenance-gated projection, atomic retry budgets, append-only action evidence, and authenticated API/CLI controls.

decisions.title: Persist transition ownership at supported writes
decisions.rationale: Payload association and timestamps cannot prove which attempt owns current Content state.

decisions.title: Fence every claim with a database generation
decisions.rationale: Late workers must be unable to write lifecycle or domain state after reclaim.

decisions.title: Keep reconciliation bounded and explicit
decisions.rationale: One-page dry-run/apply controls make rollout observable and avoid an unsafe automatic sweeper.

next_steps: Implement work packages in dependency order, beginning with contracts and additive persistence.
